evidence.excerpt: A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five benchmarks and a three-tier LLM pool, MeterRouter is (1) accurate, achieving performance comparable to the strongest MAS; (2) economical, reaching that accuracy at 82% lower cost than the strongest MAS router and extending the accuracy-cost frontier beyond the ceiling of single-agent systems; and (3) controllable, adapting its spending to the specified budget while rarely exceeding it.
